messages:
Maria (MKT): ok folks — we need a razor‑thin battlecard + 3 one‑liners vs cloud AI platforms, LLM APIs, and infra vendors. EOD tomorrow. Keep it sales‑friendly and demoable. :eyes:
Sam (PMM): ok. quick clarifying Qs — primary objection we want to kill first? price, latency, lock‑in, or reliability?
Lee (SE): priority order for field is latency -> predictable throughput -> fallback/SLAs. For infra vendors emphasize orchestration and ops cost.
Anita (Growth): for webinar hook I want: "real workloads, real $/token, real latency" with a short case study. 1 slide => headline, 2 metrics, 1 quote. :fire:
Tiago (BizDev): add inbound routing language: small teams -> hosted API; mid/enterprise -> Dedicated/Private. Need scripts for SDRs to map signals (compliance, qps, concurrency) to route.
Darren (Research): bench numbers we can cite (internal, draft): p50 gen latency: Redwood 45ms vs CloudA 120ms; 1M token cost: Redwood baseline 30% lower on typical user mixes. Will attach CSV. (don't publish raw numbers without PR ok)
bench-bot: uploaded /shared/benchmarks/q1_micro_v2.csv — pinned.
Maria (MKT): noted Darren — PR will sign off. We can use relative language like "substantially lower latency and unit cost" until approved.
Kai (Eng): suggestion for battlecard layout: 1) Topline claim 2) Supporting metric (one sentence) 3) Rebuttal to common counterclaim 4) Demo snippet / config. Example demo snippet:
```
# demo routing policy
route: latency_first
fallback: small_quantized_variant
```
Lee (SE): love that. For SEs add a quick troubleshooting checklist: how to interpret token breakdowns in Console, where to look for cache hits, and how to enable fallback.
Beth (Sales Ops): scripts for SDRs: 3 quick Qs to route leads — (1) Is data regulated? (2) Peak QPS? (3) Do you need guaranteed latency? If yes to any -> mark as "Enterprise (SRE review)". I'll draft playbook.
Tiago (BizDev): also need competitor soundbytes: Cloud vendors -> "managed but variable economics + lock‑in"; LLM APIs -> "fast to start, risky at scale"; Infra vendors -> "you build and operate, ops tax". Keep <20 words each.
Sam (PMM): I'll draft 3 crisp soundbites per competitor and post here. Plan: one claim, one evidence line, one rebuttal/snippet.
Anita (Growth): webinar narrative: start with demo generating 2 outputs (low latency dev flow vs heavy batch). Then panel w/ SE on cost controls. CTA: try Hosted free credits -> show Dedicated pricing calculator.
Maria (MKT): action items: Sam -> soundbites & 1‑pager; Lee -> SE demo checklist & 30s demo script; Beth -> SDR routing playbook; Darren -> final vetted metrics for PR; Anita -> webinar outline. Sync 9:30am tomorrow. Everyone ok?
Lee (SE): ok from me.
Sam (PMM): on it — will post drafts by 4pm.
Darren (Research): will get PR looped and send approved phrasing by 6pm.
Maria (MKT): perfect. thanks team :rocket:
